King's Recruit#002.src: You three are going to make fine soldiers. Now, go on to {p}, the King is awaiting your arrival.
King's Recruit#002.dst: お前たち三人は立派な兵士になるだろう。さあ、{c2}{p} へ向かえ{/}。王がお前たちの到着を待っている。
King's Recruit#002.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#003.src: Well, what are we waiting for?
King's Recruit#003.dst: 何をぐずぐずしてんだ？行くぞ！

King's Recruit#006.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#006.dst: おい、{u}！中は大丈夫か？何かにぶつかったみたいだ。

King's Recruit#007.src: Hey, {u}! Are you alright in there? It looks like we've hit something.
King's Recruit#007.dst: おい、{u}！ 中は大丈夫か？ 何かにぶつかったみたいだ。

King's Recruit#008.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#008.dst: キャラバンを降りて、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる御者と話す。

King's Recruit#009.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#009.dst: キャラバンを降りて、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる御者と話す

King's Recruit#010.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#010.dst: うーん… この道を通るたびに、毎回同じ岩にぶつかってる気がする。すまんね、みなさん。
King's Recruit#010.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#011.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#011.dst: ああ。ここから {p} まで歩かなきゃいけないってこと？
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#012.dst: 残念ながらね。幸い、ここからそう遠くない。まっすぐ進むだけさ。
King's Recruit#012.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#013.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#013.dst: まあ、進むしかないな！Tasim、{u}、門まで競争だ！
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#015.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#015.dst: …もう行っちゃった。追いつかなきゃね。{u}、先導してくれる？
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#016.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#016.dst: 道を進み、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある Wynn 地方への門へ向かう。

King's Recruit#017.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#017.dst: 道を進み、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある Wynn 地方への門へ向かう

King's Recruit#018.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#018.dst: 君も Wynn のことはあまり知らないよね？
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#019.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#019.dst: {p} の王が Fruma の兵を募ってるのは知ってるけど…
King's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#020.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#020.dst: これだけ支援が要るなんて、向こうの戦争はかなりひどいことになってるんだろうね。
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#021.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#021.dst: あ、Aledar がいた！門もあるみたいだ。
King's Recruit#021.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#022.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#022.dst: 遅かったな！アンデッドと渡り合いたいなら、もっと速くならないとね。
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#023.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time.
King's Recruit#023.dst: はいはい、次はもっと速くするよ。
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#024.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.dst: はいはい、次はもっと速くするよ。それで、これが Wynn と Fruma の境の門かな？
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#025.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#025.dst: そうみたいだな！二人とも、新しい人生を始める準備はいいか？
King's Recruit#025.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#026.src: Looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#026.dst: そうみたいだな！ 二人とも、新しい人生を始める準備はいいか？
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#027.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#027.dst: {u}、この名誉ある役目は君に譲るよ。{c2}門を開けてくれ{/}。
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#028.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#028.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] から Wynn 地方に入る。

King's Recruit#029.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#029.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] から Wynn 地方に入る

King's Recruit#030.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#030.dst: 何をぐずぐずしてるんだ？この地方を探検しに行こう。
King's Recruit#030.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#031.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#031.dst: Wynn 地方を進み、城を目指す

King's Recruit#032.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#032.dst: これがみんなが噂してた Wynn か……美しい
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#033.src: So this is the Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#033.dst: これがずっと話に聞いていた Wynn か……美しい
King's Recruit#033.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#034.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#034.dst: 戦争はまだここまで来てないみたいだな。僕たちはこれを守るために戦うんだ！
King's Recruit#034.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#035.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#035.dst: おい、新兵ども！こっちへ来い、話がある。
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#038.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#038.dst: 兵士さん？こんな所で何をしているんですか？
King's Recruit#038.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#039.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#039.dst: この先で少し厄介なことがあってな。新兵をここで引き止めるよう言われてるんだ。
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#040.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#040.dst: ここで生き延びたいなら、これが必要になる。
King's Recruit#040.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#043.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#043.dst: まだこれを使わずに済むといいんだけどね。
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#044.dst: 達者でな、新兵たち！{c2}この道を進めば{/}、この先に橋があるぞ！
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#045.src: Just follow this path straight forward, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#045.dst: {c2}この道を{/}まっすぐ{c2}進めば{/}、先に橋がある。
King's Recruit#045.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#048.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#048.dst: ああ、きっとこれがあの兵士の言ってた橋だね。でも見るからにすごく…
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#049.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#049.dst: よし、{p} の王を待たせるわけにはいかないぞ！
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#053.dst: それを注意しようとしたのに！残りが崩れる前に橋から降りて！
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#054.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#054.dst: で、この谷の向こうにどうやって渡るんだ？また失敗か？あの時みたいに――…
King's Recruit#054.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#056.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#056.dst: 変だな… Wynn に来る前のことを考えてたんだが… 消えた。思い出せない。
King's Recruit#056.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#057.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#057.dst: うーん。僕も Fruma のことが何も思い出せないな… {u}、君はどう？
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#058.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#058.dst: 何も。全員が同時に記憶をなくすなんて、偶然なわけないよな？
King's Recruit#058.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#059.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we've all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#059.dst: 何も。みんな同時に記憶をなくすなんて、偶然のはずがないよな？
King's Recruit#059.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#060.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#060.dst: うん、でも… それは後で考えよう。今はこの谷を越える方法を探さないと。Aledar、{u}、{c2}渡れる所を探してきて{/}。僕はここを調べてるよ。
King's Recruit#060.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#062.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#062.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で谷を渡る別の方法を探す。

King's Recruit#063.src: Find another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#063.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で渓谷を渡る別の道を探す

King's Recruit#064.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#064.dst: おお！うまくいったな、{u}。いい考えだ！
King's Recruit#064.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#065.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#065.dst: おーい、Tasim！こっちだ、{u} が道を見つけたぞ！
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#068.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#068.dst: ふう！今度は無事に渡れたね。
King's Recruit#068.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#069.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#069.dst: このまま進めば、すぐに {p} に着くはずだ！
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#070.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#070.dst: ん？あの衛兵、ここで何をしてるんだろう？話しかけないとここは通れなそうだね。
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#071.src: Hm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#071.dst: ん？ あの衛兵、こんなところで何してるんだろう？ 話しかけないとここは通れなそうだね。
King's Recruit#071.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#076.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#076.dst: 腐敗した者どもがこの地下道を占拠した。防具なしでは通せん。
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#077.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#077.dst: じゃあどうすれば？{p} に行かなきゃならないんだ！
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#078.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#078.dst: あそこの洞窟が見えるか？ああいう洞窟には、生き延びるのに役立つ戦利品がよくある。
King's Recruit#078.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#079.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#079.dst: {c2}洞窟に入れば{/}、{c2}身を守る防具が見つかる{/}はずだ。そうしたら戻ってこい。
King's Recruit#079.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#080.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#080.dst: どうだ、{u}？あの洞窟に何があるか見に行こう。
King's Recruit#080.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#081.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#081.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟に入って防具を探す。

King's Recruit#082.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#082.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟に入って防具を探す

King's Recruit#083.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#083.dst: 衛兵の所に戻って、今度は通してくれるか確かめよう！
King's Recruit#083.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#084.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#084.dst: 防具を見つけたみたいだな？
King's Recruit#084.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#085.src: So you found some armour, huh?
King's Recruit#085.dst: 防具を見つけたみたいだな？
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#086.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#086.dst: ああ、ヘルメットだ！通してくれるか？
King's Recruit#086.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#087.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#087.dst: 待て、新兵。防具を装備する前に、まず鑑定しなければならない。
King's Recruit#087.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#088.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armour you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#088.dst: 待て、新兵。防具を装備する前に、{c2}まず鑑定しなければならない{/}。
King's Recruit#088.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#089.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#089.dst: どうやって鑑定するの？
King's Recruit#089.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#090.src: You can identify items at {#} Item Identifiers. They're found in towns across the whole world, but we have one here for recruits such as yourselves.
King's Recruit#090.dst: アイテムは {#} {c2}アイテム鑑定士{/}に鑑定してもらうんだ。世界中の町にいるが、お前たち新兵のためにここにも一人いる。
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#091.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#091.dst: アイテム鑑定士にヘルメットを鑑定してもらって、装備してから戻ってこい。そうしたら通してやる。
King's Recruit#091.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#092.src: Identify your helmet at the {#} Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#092.dst: {#} {c2}アイテム鑑定士{/}にヘルメットを鑑定してもらって、{c3}装備してから戻ってこい{/}。そうしたら通してやる。
King's Recruit#092.speaker: Guard
King's Recruit#092.note: {c2}Item Identifiers{/} {c3}return to me with it equipped{/}

King's Recruit#093.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#093.dst: ヘルメットを着けたようだな。よし、通っていいぞ。門を開けてやろう。
King's Recruit#093.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#094.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this for you.
King's Recruit#094.dst: ヘルメットを着けたようだな。よし、通っていいぞ。門を開けてやろう。
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#095.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#095.dst: 気をつけろよ、新兵ども！防具があっても楽じゃないぞ！
King's Recruit#095.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#096.src: Good luck in there, recruits! Even with your new armour, it's not going to be so easy!
King's Recruit#096.dst: 気をつけろよ、新兵ども！ 新しい防具があっても楽じゃないぞ！
King's Recruit#096.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#100.dst: 地下道を抜けて [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ進む

King's Recruit#101.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#101.dst: ああ、本当に衛兵の言った通りだね。ここは腐敗した連中だらけだ。
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#102.src: That guard wasn't kidding. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#102.dst: ああ、本当に衛兵の言った通りだね。ここは腐敗した連中だらけだ。
King's Recruit#102.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#103.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#103.dst: 正面突破するしかないね！やっと手に入れた武器を使う時だ。行くぞ、{u}。
King's Recruit#103.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#104.src: Finally, time for us to use these weapons we got!
King's Recruit#104.dst: ついに、もらった武器を使う時が来たぞ！
King's Recruit#104.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#105.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#105.dst: {u}、前のスケルトンを頼む。後ろのゾンビ二体は僕たちがやる！
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#108.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#108.dst: 道が開いた。地下道を進もう。
King's Recruit#108.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#109.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#109.dst: こっちだ！ちょうどいい所に！
King's Recruit#109.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#112.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#112.dst: やっと援軍か！待てよ… お前たち、Fruma から来たばかりだな？
King's Recruit#112.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#113.src: Finally some backup! Wait a second... You're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#113.dst: やっと援軍か！ ちょっと待て……お前たち、Fruma から来たばかりだな？
King's Recruit#113.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#114.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#114.dst: まあ、このあたりはもう片付いたはずだ。{p} はすぐそこだしな。
King's Recruit#114.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#115.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead after all.
King's Recruit#115.dst: まあ、このあたりはもう片付いたはずだ。{p} はすぐそこだしな。
King's Recruit#115.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#117.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#117.dst: {c1}急げ、アビリティを使うんだ！{/}
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#118.src: Now cast your spell with your weapon!
King's Recruit#118.dst: さあ、武器で呪文を唱えろ！
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#120.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#120.dst: 待て、逃げるな！中尉を助けるぞ！
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#122.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.
King's Recruit#122.dst: Goliath を倒して中尉を救出する。

King's Recruit#123.src: ... That was close. Thanks for the save, recruits!
King's Recruit#123.dst: ……危なかった。助かったよ、新兵たち！
King's Recruit#123.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#124.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#124.dst: 危なかった… 助かったぞ、{u}！
King's Recruit#124.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#125.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#125.dst: お前たち三人はいい兵士になるだろう。今みたいに立ち回れる奴はそう多くない。
King's Recruit#125.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#126.src: I think you three are going to make fine soldiers, not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#126.dst: お前たち三人はいい兵士になるだろう。今みたいに立ち回れる奴はそう多くない。
King's Recruit#126.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#127.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#127.dst: あの獣が何か落としたみたいだ。{p} に向かう前に確認しておくんだな。
King's Recruit#127.speaker: Lieutenant
